# A C API call yields an integer only when the top-level statement sequence has a value.
let x = 3; => error:expected integer
fn f() { 7 }; => error:expected integer
let x = 3; fn f() { x }; => error:expected integer
let x = 3; x => 3
fn f() { 7 }; f() => 7
let x = 3; x = 4; => 4
while 0 { 1 }; => 0
1; let x = 3; => 1
{ let x = 3; x } => 3
let x = ; => error:expected integer
